assertions.name: s1_base_p_rewrite_exact
assertions.source: sympy exact (k <= 12, p = pt^2 so ptilde = sqrt(p) is polynomial): [k]_q! = p^(-k(k-1)/2)(p;p)_k/(1-p)^k and m_k = q^(-k(k-1)/4)[k]_q! = ptilde^(-k(k-1)/2)(p;p)_k/(1-p)^k — the balanced family = [Gaussian factor at base qtilde] x [q-Pochhammer factor at base q]

assertions.name: s2_sw_lognormal_affine_closure_exact
assertions.source: sympy exact: LN(mu,s2) moments exp(k mu + k^2 s2/2) (log-QUADRATIC in k); affine-in-log pushforward s -> c s^a keeps log-quadraticity (LN -> LN(ln c + a mu, a^2 s2)); classical SW weight (g/sqrt(pi))exp(-g^2 ln^2 x) has normalized moments t_sw^(-k(k+2)/2), t_sw = e^(-1/(2g^2)) — the Stieltjes 1894 log-normal example

assertions.name: s3_sw_proper_no_match_exact_obstruction
assertions.source: exact: Delta^2 ln m_k = ln qtilde + ln((1-p^(k+2))/(1-p^(k+1))) — the second factor is > 1 and strictly decreasing to 1 (exact at p = 9/10; symbolic identity for the second ratio verified k <= 7) => ln m_k is NOT quadratic in k; log-quadraticity is invariant under every affine-in-log map (S2) => NO map s -> c s^a carries the balanced family to ANY SW-proper (log-normal) moment family. Scope-(b) exclusion with cited invariant. Deviation from quadratic at the pins is O(1) at accessible orders (residual -0.29 nats at k = 3, -25.6 nats at k = 12), asymptotic Delta^2 decay rate p^k.

assertions.name: s4_sw_exact_factor_decomposition
assertions.source: symbolic: m_k = G_k J_k with G_k = LN(-L/2, L) moments = the classical SW weight at t_sw = e^(-L) = 1/qtilde pushed by s -> s qtilde^(-3/2) (exact); numeric: the Jackson atomic measure (p;p)_oo sum p^m/(p;p)_m delta_{p^m/(1-p)} has moments (p;p)_k/(1-p)^k via Euler's q-exponential (rel < 1e-30 at q = 1.2 + both pins, k <= 8) — support in (0, 1/(1-p)] compact => determinate. Balanced = SW(base qtilde) (*) Jackson: the indeterminacy core IS Stieltjes' 1894 example.

assertions.name: s5_q_laguerre_one_sided_exact_identification
assertions.source: exact: the alpha=0 q-Laguerre weight 1/(-x;p)_oo satisfies w(px) = (1+x)w(x) => nu_{k+1} = p^(-(k+1))(1-p^(k+1)) nu_k (quadrature cross-check rel < 1e-20 at p = 5/6 + both pins, k <= 6) => rho_k = p^(-k(k+1)/2)(p;p)_k; symbolic k <= 12: [k]_q! = rho_k (p/(1-p))^k — the ONE-SIDED normalizer family IS the q-Laguerre (Moak) family under the exact scaling s -> (p/(1-p)) s; balanced = one-sided deconvolved by exactly one SW Gaussian LN(-L/2, L)

description: KSel-2-ID (bean qou-0ms0; audit-only, scope-(a), NO FIT, nothing wired): literature identification of the balanced binding-kernel moment family m_k = q^(-k(k-1)/4)[k]_q! against the classical Stieltjes-Wigert / q-Laguerre indeterminate families. S1: exact base-p rewrite (Gaussian factor at base qtilde x Pochhammer factor at base q). S2-S3: SW-proper (log-normal) moment sequences are log-quadratic, a property invariant under every affine-in-log map s -> c s^a; the balanced family is exactly NOT log-quadratic (Delta^2 ln m_k = ln qtilde + ln((1-p^(k+2))/(1-p^(k+1))), strictly increasing) => NO-MATCH to SW-proper, scope-(b) with cited invariant. S4: the SW structure IS present as an exact tensor factor: balanced = SW(t = 1/qtilde, scaled) (*) Jackson (determinate, compact support) — the indeterminacy core is Stieltjes' 1894 log-normal example at base sqrt(q), = the ksel3 Gaussian. S5: the ONE-SIDED normalizer [k]_q! is EXACTLY the alpha=0 q-Laguerre (Moak/generalized-SW) moment family under s -> (p/(1-p)) s (weight functional equation derivation + quadrature cross-check); the balanced member sits exactly one SW-Gaussian convolution away — the bar-symmetric half-dressed point. Nothing here proves or refutes any conjecture.

s1_base_p.balanced: m_k = ptilde^(-k(k-1)/2)(p;p)_k/(1-p)^k = e^(L k(k-1)/2) (p;p)_k/(1-p)^k, L = ln qtilde
s1_base_p.reading: Gaussian (log-quadratic) part at base qtilde = sqrt(q); Pochhammer part at base q — MIXED bases: the balanced convention is the half-step (bar-symmetric) point

s3_obstruction.delta2_identity: m_{k+2} m_k / m_{k+1}^2 = qtilde * (1-p^(k+2))/(1-p^(k+1)) — exact symbolic
s3_obstruction.verdict_sw_proper: NO-MATCH (exact): the q-Pochhammer factor cannot be produced by any affine-in-log rescaling of a log-normal
s3_obstruction.near_rate: deviation of Delta^2 from constant ~ p^(k+1)(1-p) -> 0: the family is SW-proper only asymptotically

s4_sw_factor.decomposition: m_k = G_k * J_k exactly; G_k = SW/log-normal (sigma^2 = L = ln qtilde, mu = -L/2 — the ksel3 'one Gaussian'); J_k = Jackson, determinate (compact support)
s4_sw_factor.reading: the u-translate/extension indeterminacy of the balanced kernel family is carried ENTIRELY by the classical SW factor (christiansen2003sw, berg1995 frame); the Jackson dressing is determinate

s5_q_laguerre.moment_recurrence: nu_{k+1}/nu_k = p^(-(k+1))(1-p^(k+1)) — derived from w(px) = (1+x)w(x), exact
s5_q_laguerre.balanced_bridge: m_k = p^(k(k-1)/4) [k]_q!: exactly one SW-Gaussian factor (LN(-L/2, L)) between balanced and one-sided/q-Laguerre; NOT affine-in-log (S3 obstruction)
